name: accessible-learning-sites
description: Turn one teacher-provided lesson into one teacher-reviewed, accessibility-first lesson Site.

interface.shortDescription: Build accessible lesson Sites for the whole class.
interface.longDescription: Includes two teacher workflows. Create Accessible Learning Site turns one local lesson source into a source-faithful, accessibility-first Site with equivalent learning pathways. Schedule Accessible Lesson Intake optionally watches a chosen workspace folder daily or weekly and drafts a Site when new lesson materials arrive.
defaultPrompt: Turn today's lesson materials into an accessible lesson Site.
Create an accessible math lesson Site for my class.
Build a lesson Site from a local PDF, Word, PowerPoint, or spreadsheet file.
